newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends stronger in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends stronger in range trading.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed slightly firmer at 26.374 to the dollar after vacillating within a very tight range throughout the session, traders said.
The peso was traded either in 26.374 or 26.373 amid light turnover of $118.58 million.
The peso closed at 26.375 on Friday due to arbitrage play.
"The market was very boring today. The Central Bank and the foreign banks weren't there," one trader said from a large local commercial bank.
The decline in the Treasury bill auction rates was too slight to trigger any dollar buying, she added.
Another trader said some bankers bought dollars at 26.366 for value-today, and sold them later at 26.374 for value-tomorrow.
"Some traders just made some trading gains on that. Aside from that, I don't see any excitement in the market," he said.
Traders expected the peso to remain stuck within the present range for the next few days.
